Task: `8c7e2d15-3f17-41a1-b905-99ca5e536c83`. Stage asks whether the branch
changes comply with `./docs/KB Code Standards.md`. This review is read-only
(docs-only stage; only this file written). No live mutation: no
reinstall / env-edit / restart / rediscovery / DELETE (survey q1 + parent
q23 binding — the agent RECOMMENDS runner restarts, it never executes them).

## Scope (code files only; 90+ docs files excluded)

Local HEAD `cec79eec` vs `origin/main` (`git diff origin/main...HEAD`):
- `runner/daemon.js` (+145) + `runner/daemon.test.js` (+169)
- `scripts/package-runner.mjs` (+203), `scripts/package-runner.sh` (+31),
  `scripts/lib/runner-install-root.sh` (+17)
- `tests/package-runner-conformance.test.mjs` (+158),
  `tests/install-runner-wrapper.test.mjs` (+60),
  `tests/runner-release-manifest.test.mjs` (+6)

Local checkout is 4 commits behind the branch tip
(`origin/kb/8c7e2d15-3f17-41a1-b905-99ca5e536c83`); the remote tip adds
`scripts/lib/bundle-receipt.sh` + `tests/bundle-receipt.test.mjs`, the
`runner-install-root.sh` staging-swap, and `packageRunner` JSDoc. Those
were reviewed via `git diff`/`git show` only (not checked out); their
tests were not executed here (flagged as unverified below).

## Verdict: COMPLIANT

- **Understandable over technical language.** New exports use long,
  descriptive names (`daemonFolder`, `statusPaths`, `missingPaths`,
  `parsePackagerArgs`, `validatePackageSourceTree`,
  `isSkippedCodeTreeFile`, `resolveCodeTreeScanRoot`). Every new export
  carries a `MARK:` label in its JSDoc block directly above the export
  with an `@example` tag (`isSkippedCodeTreeFile`,
  `resolveCodeTreeScanRoot`, `CODE_TREE_SCAN_ROOT`,
  `CODE_TREE_SKIP_FILE_NAMES/SUFFIXES`, `parsePackagerArgs`,
  `validatePackageSourceTree`; internal `copyPruned` also has both).
  All new public functions use the labelled pattern
  (`{ fileName }`, `{ daemonDir }`, `{ args }`, `{ root }`). JSDoc is
  plain English and states the *why* (WP-F false positive, NB…,
  fail-fast-before-staging). `grep -i factory|barrel|pattern|class`
  over the diff is empty — no design-pattern language, no classes.
- **Functional over object oriented.** No classes added. `parsePackagerArgs`
  is pure and never mutates its input (copies the argv slice; tested).
  New resolvers/predicates fail quiet and never throw
  (`resolveCodeTreeScanRoot`, `isSkippedCodeTreeFile`, `resolveRunnerBuild`).
  Function names are verbs/predicates (`parse`, `validate`, `resolve`,
  `isSkipped…`, matching the existing `hasCodeChangedSinceBoot` family).
- **Co-location over abstraction.** `daemon.test.js` sits next to
  `daemon.js`; packager/installer tests extend the existing `tests/`
  files that already own them (no new location invented). The shared
  receipt helper lives at the lowest common folder (`scripts/lib/`).
- **Tested over trusted.** Touched-area suites pass on this HEAD:
  `node --test runner/daemon.test.js` 188/188, and
  `package-runner-conformance` + `runner-release-manifest` +
  `install-runner-wrapper` 46/46. Coverage matches new behavior:
  artifact skip (`daemon.js~`, `.bak*`, `.log/.tmp`, OS junk) vs real
  code (`my.bakery.js` still counts), bundle-vs-checkout scan root,
  cli dirty-scope siblings (`runner/` + `../shared` + `../api`), bare
  `--out` rejection, fail-fast source validation with no partial
  tarball, symlink-cycle safety, REF-vs-HEAD guard, lay-down asserts,
  pi-leg warn-not-fail. `npm run check:jsdoc-example` = PASS
  (679 missing vs 680 grandfathered baseline).

## Honest limitations (not standards failures)

- `node --test runner/*.test.js` (full runner suite) cannot load
  `runner/harnessModelDiscovery.test.js` in this worktree:
  `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND 'uuid'` because `api/node_modules` is absent.
  Environmental, unrelated to this branch (the branch does not touch
  `api/flow/runnerRegistry.js`; `uuid` is a declared api dep).
- Remote-only `tests/bundle-receipt.test.mjs` and the staging-swap in
  `runner-install-root.sh` were reviewed by diff only, never executed
  locally — unverified by execution.
- Minor, non-blocking: `copyPruned(src, dest, …)` and `snapshotCodeTree(rootDir)`
  keep pre-existing positional signatures; every *new* public API in this
  branch uses the labelled pattern.

## Live-state note

Code-standards compliance does not move live WP-F state. Per runs 50/51,
`server2-alpha` Bundle B and the `local-bravo` paused regression still
require operator action, and the explicit human grant (q3/q4) is still
absent — so WP-G readiness and §6 live checks remain operator-pending.
Recommendation to operator (not executed here): server2-alpha Bundle B
if not yet installed, bravo unpause decision, explicit DELETE grant,
then live §6.3 UI pass.

151|## Restart sequence (all runners, one at a time)
152|
153|1. Pick a QUIESCENT window per runner: no active task agent on the runner
154|   being restarted (`GET /status` engine idle + runner has no live
155|   assignment; Settings → Runners). NEVER restart all runners at once.

160|   `discoveryStatus` (below) before the next.
161|4. After all restarts: trigger `requestModelRediscovery` from Settings
162|   (Re-scan), or per runner:
163|   `curl -X POST http://192.168.1.206:3100/runners/<id>/commands -H

168|

170|`bin/kainbain-runner` vs direct `node runner/main.js`),
171|`KAINBAIN_RUNNER_MODELS` removed or exact remaining value, and fresh
172|`GET /runners` excerpts: `modelSource` (expect `discovered` or
173|`pinned+discovered`), `discoveryStatus` (expect one key per configured

182|still queues `requestModelRediscovery` (202), but its discovery never

184|decision that must be recorded as intent, not left as an accident).

192|`node_modules` — and re-scans every heartbeat, so `true` means a file

202|## Phase 4 transfer note (agent executes, operator permits — read before granting)
203|
204|The purge agent runs (URL-encoded id):
205|`DELETE /runners/models/catalogue/<id>` → 204 gone, 404
206|`UNKNOWN_MODEL` already absent (both are non-errors for the purge
207|target); `DELETE /runners/models/catalogue/quarantine/<id>` likewise
208|for quarantined rows. A re-advertised id legitimately reappears on the
209|next snapshot update — absence is confirmed by a fresh GET, never by
210|the DELETE status alone. Auth: both routes need the admin role, and
211|API keys are explicitly refused (`allowApiKeys: false` — keys get 403
212|`forbidden`); while access control is OFF (current live state) the
213|routes are open. If access control is ever ON, 401/403 means "auth",
214|NOT "absent" — the purge run must use a human admin session, and a
215|403 must never be misread as purge-complete. There is deliberately NO
216|runner-record DELETE endpoint (only revoke/pause/resume), so a
217|"delete the revoked runner completely" grant is infeasible via API —
218|revoked records stay for audit.
219|
220|## Addendum 2026-11-14 (agent safe action) — systemd user-level pin trap
221|
222|`~/.kainbain/runner-local-{alpha,bravo}.env` is NOT the only source of
223|`KAINBAIN_RUNNER_MODELS`. `local-alpha` was inheriting a 17-model pin
224|from the systemd *user* environment (`systemctl --user show-environment`),
225|so the env-file removal alone never took effect and the upgraded daemon
226|kept reporting `modelSource: pinned` with `discoveryStatus: {}`. Bravo did
227|not inherit it. Before restarting any runner, the operator MUST:
228|
229|```bash
230|systemctl --user unset-environment KAINBAIN_RUNNER_MODELS
231|# also check persistence:
232|grep -R KAINBAIN_RUNNER_MODELS ~/.config/environment.d 2>/dev/null || true
233|```
234|
235|Only after the user environment is clean will a post-WP-B restart flip
236|`modelSource` to `discovered`/`pinned+discovered`.
237|

2|
3|Task: `8c7e2d15-3f17-41a1-b905-99ca5e536c83` · Parent bug: `b3401f19-2897-4049-aa3c-227bcee46a4c`

6|Plan type: rollout / migration (ops runbook + live-state cleanup + verification). No product code changes; docs and operator handoffs only.
7|
8|## Goal
9|
10|Bring the live fleet onto the fixed catalogue stack (WP-A + WP-B + WP-C deployed, WP-E merged) and purge test pollution from live engine state, leaving zero `test-fleet` entries and a catalogue that satisfies RESPONSE.md §6 — without the agent ever touching a running task runner itself.
11|
12|## Success Criteria
13|
14|1. Gates honoured: WP-A, WP-B, WP-C merged and deployed (backend image rebuilt to a recorded commit), WP-E merged; WP-D status recorded (preferred, not blocking); explicit human permission recorded before any live-state step.
15|2. Agent performed only pre-approved live actions: read-only checks + DELETE of test/dummy catalogue entries via the WP-C admin route. All runner reinstall / env-edit / restart steps were executed by the human operator from agent-provided instructions (never by the agent).
16|3. RESPONSE.md §6 passes end to end: §3.1 shows `discovered`/`pinned+discovered` + per-harness `ok:true`, `versions.build.sha` matches deployed commit, `codeChangedSinceBoot: false`; §3.2 shows no `bare`/`provider` entries, no `test-fleet-model`, every entry `harnesses.length === 1`; UI checks pass; regression check passes; named `npm test` suites pass; WP-E guard proves no suite touched `~/.kainbain/engine`.
17|4. Live state contains zero `test-fleet` entries: `muse::meta::test-fleet-model` gone from `fleet-catalog.json`; revoked runner `test-fleet-muse` left revoked for audit (survey q4 asks delete-completely, but no runner-record DELETE endpoint exists — operator explicitly accepts the infeasibility or removes it out-of-band).
18|5. Execution evidence is recorded in this task's docs folder (gate record, operator handoff receipts, verification log) so WP-G can be decision-gated on it.
19|
20|## Approach
21|
22|"Make change easy, then make the change": the agent does all of the safe, reversible preparation itself (Phases 0–1: gate checks, read-only rehearsal, exact operator commands, backups, dry-run verification scripts), then hands precisely two execution bundles to the operator (Phases 2–3: reinstall/env/restart — recommended, never executed by the agent), then performs only the pre-approved purge itself (Phase 4), then verifies everything against §6 (Phase 5) and records the evidence WP-G needs (Phase 6).
23|
24|Big/risky items come first: permission + gate verification and the self-kill-safe restart sequencing are resolved before any live state is touched; the irreversible DELETE comes only after WP-E-merged is proven (no re-pollution) and backups exist.

10|

13|quarantine, derived reasons). Evidence: probes `/tmp/update-break-probe.mjs` (33 pass),

18|

20|  bare/provider entries quarantine with claimant-union `runnerIds` + original timestamps

35|

52|
